Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

In a large bowl, combine the butter, brown sugar, and white sugar. Mix until smooth and well combined. Do not cream. 2. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla, then mix until fully incorporated. 3. Add the dry ingredients (flour, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt) and fold until just combined. 4. Fold in the chocolate chips or chunks until evenly distributed. Do not overmix. 5. Divide the dough into 150g portions and shape each into a rough ball. 6. Place the dough balls on a lined tray, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. 7. Bake in a preheated 190°C (375°F) oven for 13-16 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are still slightly soft. 8. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking tray for a few minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. If desired, sprinkle with flaky sea salt and let cool for about 15 minutes before serving. Enjoy! Pt.4 | My fall bakery menu 🍂 Recipe below 👇🏼  Crumbl released their Dubai Chocolate Brownie, but why buy it when you can make an even better one at home? 🤎✨ Ingredients 🟤Brownie Base * 180g caster sugar * 2 eggs * 113g unsalted butter (for browning) * 170g chopped chocolate * 80g plain flour * 3 tbsp cocoa powder * ½ tsp salt 💚Kunafa Filling * 260g kunafa pastry (finely chopped) * 2 tbsp unsalted butter (for toasting kunafa) * 320g pistachio cream 🍫Chocolate Ganache * 120g double cream * 100g milk chocolate (chopped) Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking pan with parchment paper. 2. Brown 113g of unsalted butter in a saucepan until golden, then set aside. 3. Melt the chopped chocolate in the microwave in short bursts until smooth, then stir in the browned butter and let cool slightly. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. 5. Add the chocolate butter mixture to the eggs and sugar, and whisk until fully combined. 6. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until just incorporated. 7. Pour all of the brownie batter into the prepared pan, smooth the top, and bake for 22 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan. 8. In a pan over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp of butter. Add the finely chopped kunafa pastry and cook, stirring often, until golden and crisp. Let cool slightly. 9. Mix the toasted kunafa pastry with the pistachio cream until fully combined, then spread evenly over the cooled brownie. 10. Place the pan in the fridge for about 30 minutes to set. 11. For the ganache, place the double cream and chopped milk chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in short bursts, stirring in between, until melted and glossy. 12. Pour the ganache over the pistachio-kunafa layer, spread evenly, and refrigerate, ideally overnight, or at least 1 hour before slicing. Enjoy! 🤎 #baking #dubaichocolate #brownies #Recipe #fall
